causalMap.A1: The order contract permits at most one economic charge and one auditable receipt per logical order.
causalMap.B2: The deployed provider or integration maps equal client keys to distinct provider operations.
causalMap.C2: The provider contract or request-shaping boundary must enforce operation identity before charge settlement.
causalMap.D1: The provider and ledger show two charges and two receipt events for one order.

verificationBoundary: provider operation identity → one settlement → one ledger charge → one receipt → parent order invariant
